title_zh: My life — 第1节可背诵讲义
body_en: My elder sister is an engineer. She lives in a flat in Germany. Her dream is to see Japan and the world. Everyone in our family is friendly. What is your hobby? Tell us about yourself — your age and your country. German grammar sounds hard, but we can learn.
body_zh: 我姐姐是工程师，住在德国的一套公寓。她的梦想是去看看日本和更广阔的世界。我们家人都很友善。你的爱好是什么？介绍一下你自己——年龄和家乡。德语语法听起来难，但我们能学。
